26:2.text: These are the Verses of the manifest Book
[(this Qur’ân), which was promised by Allâh in the Taurât (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel), makes things clear]

26:3.text: are going to kill yourself with grief, that they do not become believers
[in your Risalah (Messengership) i.e. in your Message of Islâmic Monotheism]

26:4.text: If We will, We could send down to them from the heaven a sign, to which they would bend their necks in humility.

26:5.text: And never comes there unto them a Reminder as a recent revelation from the Most Gracious

26:6.text: , then the news of what they mocked at will come to them.

26:7.text: Do they not observe the earth - how much of every good kind We cause to grow therein?

26:8.text: Verily, in this is an Ayâh
(polytheists, pagans who do not believe in Resurrection)

26:9.text: And verily your Lord, He is truly the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

26:10.text: : "Go to the people who are Zâlimûn

26:11.text: : Will they not fear Allâh and become righteous?"

26:12.text: He said: "My Lord! Verily, I fear that they will belie me,

26:13.text: "And my breast straitens, and my tongue expresses not well. So send for Hârûn

26:14.text: "And they have a charge of crime against me, and I fear they will kill me."

26:15.text: said: "Nay! Go you both with Our Signs. Verily We shall be with you, listening.

26:16.text: "And go both of you to Fir‘aun
, and say: ‘We are the Messengers of the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn

26:17.text: "So allow the Children of Israel to go with us.’ "

26:18.text: : "Did we not bring you up among us as a child? And you did dwell many years of your life with us.

26:19.text: "And you did your deed, which you did
(i.e. the crime of killing a man)
while you were one of the ingrates."
